item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q002_mazg_hise_remote_homology","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 supports remote homology: d1vmga_ (sunid 113676) belongs to the MazG-like family a.204.1.2 (116993), whereas d1y6xa1 (122676; residues A:7–93) belongs to the HisE-like (PRA-PH) family a.204.1.4 (140797). Both families share the all-alpha NTP pyrophosphosphatases superfamily a.204.1 (101386), supporting probable common ancestry despite their separation into different families. They also share fold a.204 (101385) and class a, All alpha proteins; fold or class membership alone would not establish homology.\n\nThis classification does not establish identical substrates, catalytic specificity, physiological roles, or functional interchangeability. In particular, transferring HisE’s phosphoribosyl-ATP pyrophosphatase activity and histidine-biosynthesis role to d1vmga_, or transferring MazG-associated nucleotide specificity or cellular roles to d1y6xa1, would exceed the evidence. SCOPe labels the d1vmga_ protein as hypothetical protein SSo12199 (SSo3215), so “MazG-like” should not itself be treated as experimental functional validation. Such transfers require independent evidence from sequence and active-site comparisons, ligand-bound structures, substrate-specific biochemical assays, and physiological or genetic studies. Shared ancestry can motivate structural comparison or template consideration, but accurate active-site modeling and functional annotation require additional validation.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1vmga_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d1y6xa1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/113676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/122676","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1.2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1.4","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.204","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116994","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140801","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/116993","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140798","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/140797"]}]}
